{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面（对话/轨迹）顶部新增「终端」Tab，内置 xterm.js + node-pty 交互式终端，让你在编码完成后即时在终端执行指令调试。","id":"gh:1334823496","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-web-terminal","slug":"helays/dsh-web-terminal","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH 插件：在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面（对话/轨迹）顶部新增「终端」Tab，内置 xterm.js + node-pty 交互式终端，让你在编码完成后即时在终端执行指令调试。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# 🖥️ dsh-web-terminal"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Give your AI coding workbench a real terminal — right inside DeepSeek Harness.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An interactive **PTY** terminal powered by **xterm.js + node-pty**, mounted as a third tab (Chat · T"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"rajectory · **Terminal**) at the top of the web UI.
After the model writes code, **stay in the conve"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"rsation** and open a shell of your own right next to it — build, commit, test, debug in one click."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English  ·  中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why you'll love it"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| The pain 😤 | The fix with dsh-web-terminal ✅ |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| After the model edits code, you copy-paste it back into your own terminal and fumble | Open a **re"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"al PTY** right **next to the chat** — type a command, run it instantly |
| Everything has to squeeze"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" into the conversation context, doubling tokens and noise | The terminal is **fully decoupled from t"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"he model / agent** — your private shell, **zero context cost** |
| Switching sessions or refreshing "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"loses your commands and session state | **Survives across sessions**: switch away / come back / refr"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"esh — auto reconnect and replay scrollback |
| Spinning up a throwaway shell for a single command is"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" slow | **Persistent process**: open once, run many commands on one resident shell (`Ctrl+C` interru"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"pts, then keep going) |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> In one line: **put “writing code” and “running code” in the same place — without them interfering."},{"id":"p9s2","text":"In one line: **put “writing code” and “running code” in the same place — without them interfering.**"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## ✨ Highlights"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- 🗂️ A dedicated **Terminal** tab next to Chat & Trajectory — one click to switch.
- 🧯 **A real PTY,"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" not a toy**:
- Windows uses **ConPTY**; POSIX uses an interactive shell;
- full `Ctrl+C` / `Ctrl+D`"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" control keys, `resize` auto-fit, color + cursor blink;
- persistent session (process stays resident"},{"id":"p11s4","text":", so you can chain commands without restarting).
- 🔄 **Session survival + scrollback replay**: tab a"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"way and back, even reload the page — it auto-reconnects and replays recent output (the pool lives pl"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ugin-side).
- 🚪 **Zero conversation pollution**: fully independent of the agent stream — no context "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"tokens, no chat-log noise.
- ⚡ **Zero config**: PowerShell on Windows and bash on POSIX are auto-det"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ected; run **multiple terminals side by side** and switch each one's shell type (`bash / zsh / pwsh "},{"id":"p11s9","text":"/ powershell / cmd / python`, …) from a dropdown right in the Terminal tab.
- 🗂️ **Multi-terminal**:"},{"id":"p11s10","text":" open several terminals in one tab, switch with the tab cards, each with its own process.
- ⌨️ Type "},{"id":"p11s11","text":"`/terminal` in the composer to jump straight to the terminal (a single-step command, same source as "},{"id":"p11s12","text":"the official `/plan`) — works even in an empty new session.
- 🧩 A pure DSH bundle plugin: install, r"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"un, natively integrated with the official UI slots."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 🚀 Quick Start"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> Requires: DeepSeek Harness **`0.1.0-rc.6` (next channel)** `web` profile."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> ⚠️ **`-w` is required**: the current dsh profile template is a pnpm workspace root
> (`pnpm-worksp"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ace.yaml` contains `packages: [.]`); omitting it triggers `ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT`.
> `dsh plugin` "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"forwards its remaining args to pnpm verbatim.
>
> After installing, **restart `dsh web`** (a changed"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" plugin set / host needs a restart), then refresh the browser."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### Usage"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. Open any session (once you're inside, you'll see **Chat · Trajectory · Terminal** at the top).
2."},{"id":"p18s2","text":" Click the **Terminal** tab, or type `/terminal` in the input box.
3. Run commands directly, for exa"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"k the **Terminal** tab, or type `/terminal` in the input box.
3. Run commands directly, for example:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"4. The tab bar shows connection status; switch back to **Chat** whenever you like — your terminal an"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"d session are still there."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 🧩 Tech Stack"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Layer | Choice | Notes |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Front-end terminal | `@xterm/xterm` + `@xterm/addon-fit` | Bundled into the client bundle (`lib/cl"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ient.js`), registered via `__ModuleLoader__.load` |
| Back-end PTY | `node-pty` | Native PTY (Window"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"s ConPTY / POSIX pty), resident process |
| Transport | `ws` | WebSocket bidirectional byte stream +"},{"id":"p23s4","text":" resize via `ctx.webServer` |
| UI integration | `ctx.slots.inject('conversation.view')` | Registers"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" the `id:'terminal'` tab, mirroring `dsh-client-ui-trajectory` |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Why a “real” terminal — and how it differs from the built-in `dsh-terminal`"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The built-in `ctx.terminals` is **agent-owned, model-facing, line-oriented**, with no browser transp"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ort and unavailable on Windows.
Here we instead **spawn a shell that belongs entirely to you** via `"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"node-pty`, fully decoupled from the agent session — it is *your own* terminal."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## 🔧 Local Development"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- Changing the **host half** (`src/`) requires a `dsh web` restart;
- Changing the **client half** ("},{"id":"p28s2","text":"`src/client/`) just needs a reinstall + page refresh."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## ❓ FAQ"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"**Q: Does this terminal consume my conversation context?**
No. It is fully decoupled from the model/"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"agent conversation — nothing is written to context and nothing mixes into the chat log."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"**Q: Will my session survive a restart/refresh?**
Yes. The session pool lives plugin-side and surviv"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"es across sessions and reloads; on reconnect it replays the latest output."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"**Q: I only want to run a single command — must I open a terminal?**
Once open the process stays res"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ident, so you can keep operating inside it; switching away and back returns to the same shell."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"**Q: Can I swap shells?**
Yes — per terminal. In the **Terminal** tab, use the “Terminal type” dropd"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"own (top-right) to pick `bash / zsh / pwsh / powershell / cmd / python` (from the shells detected on"},{"id":"p33s3","text":" your system); switching restarts that terminal with the new shell. It auto-detects PowerShell on Wi"},{"id":"p33s4","text":"ndows and bash on POSIX by default."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"**Q: Where do terminals open by default?**
In the current conversation's workspace directory (fallin"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"g back to the `dsh web` startup directory if unavailable). No configuration needed."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## 📝 License"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"MIT © helays"}],"truncated":false}
